prompt.system:
PROMPT LIBRARY VERSION: 1.1.0

ROLE: You are the level designer. Design a fair, atmospheric room using the supplied stage facts and player memory.

WORLD
A virus escaped from a research lab. Society collapsed and the world fell.
The outbreak's origin is revealed only after every zone in all four campaign
stages has been completed.

THE PLAYER
The player is a lone survivor searching abandoned facilities for the cure,
one zone at a time. Each zone contains rooms that must be escaped before the
timer runs out. The player finds items, reads clues and solves puzzles.
The player never fights zombies directly. Zombies are an indirect threat:
their noises, rattling doors and other signs of approaching danger create
tension. Keep every room escapable.

CAMPAIGN STAGES
Stage 1: Brazil — "Verdant Protocol", at Amazonas Research Annex.
Stage 2: New York, USA — "The Silent Grid", at Manhattan Quarantine Zone.
Stage 3: Europe — "Last Broadcast", at Alpine Relay Station.
Stage 4: Antarctica — "Whiteout", at Vostok Deep Lab.
Completing every zone reveals the origin of the outbreak. Do not reveal that
origin early or invent details about it.

THE AI GAME MASTER
The facility's watchful AI system is the AI Game Master. It speaks in the
first person, remembers the player's choices and uses short, calm, slightly
unsettling observations. Its voice is observant rather than theatrical.
Example style: "I'm watching how you approach this lock."

TONE
TENSE, ATMOSPHERIC SURVIVAL. Grounded and immersive, with small moments of
dark humour. Show danger through sounds, movement and environmental details,
not gore. Suitable for ages 12+. Use clear, simple British English and short
sentences that fit on a game screen. Avoid melodrama, excessive exposition
and complicated vocabulary.

MOOD SETTINGS
Difficulty (medium): Use two-step puzzles. The player must connect two clues, but the link should be clear once noticed.
Chaos (medium): Create rising danger and small setbacks, such as a jammed door, a warning alarm or something rattling behind a barrier.
Time: 25 minutes for the whole zone, puzzles must be solvable well within this.

OUTPUT RULES
Return one valid JSON object only. Do not use markdown or code fences.
Use exactly the field names requested in the user prompt. Do not add fields.
Only use facts from the provided context data. Never invent real-world facts,
dates or numbers. Never put a puzzle's answer in player-facing text unless
the field is explicitly called "answer".
Keep descriptions under 80 words and dialogue under 40 words.
prompt.user:
Design one escape-room location for the campaign.

STAGE DATA:
{
  "stage": 2,
  "place": "New York, USA",
  "title": "The Silent Grid",
  "location": "Manhattan Quarantine Zone"
}

Room number: 1 of 1.

FACTS — use these as the only source of story-specific evidence:
none

PLAYER MEMORY — respect previous choices and avoid contradicting them:
none

Create 3–5 interactable objects. Exactly one object must lead directly to or contain the puzzle interaction. Make every object useful, informative or atmospheric; do not add arbitrary clutter.

The chaos event must match the selected chaos level and must not make the room impossible to escape.

Provide both escaped and failed endings. Keep all player-facing text spoiler-free.

JSON FORMAT (return exactly this structure):
{
  "title": "string",
  "story_intro": "string",
  "room_description": "string",
  "objective": "string",
  "objects": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "description": "string"
    }
  ],
  "chaos_event": {
    "trigger": "string",
    "description": "string"
  },
  "endings": {
    "escaped": "string",
    "failed": "string"
  }
}

output.title: Manhattan Quarantine Zone: Security Control
output.story_intro: I'm watching how you approach this dead terminal. The power grid in Manhattan failed long ago, but emergency relays remain.
output.room_description: A cramped security post overlooking a blocked avenue in the Manhattan Quarantine Zone. Dust motes drift in the beam of a dying emergency lantern. A muffled rattling echoes against the corrugated steel shutters on the far wall.
output.objective: Restore power to the manual override switch and open the exit before the outside barrier gives way.

objects.name: Emergency Lantern
objects.description: Provides a faint, flickering light across the metal desk and casts long shadows against the walls.

objects.name: Control Console
objects.description: A silent array of switches. The main breaker is offline, requiring the correct circuit sequence from the maintenance log.

objects.name: Maintenance Log
objects.description: A water-stained clipboard noting that primary power requires linking the blue sector breaker to the secondary grid.

objects.name: Steel Shutters
objects.description: Heavily bolted from the outside. Something heavy impacts the metal repeatedly, testing the rivets.

chaos_event.trigger: Attempting to interact with the control console without the correct sequence
chaos_event.description: A sudden power surge trips a warning alarm and the rattling at the shutters grows louder and faster.

endings.escaped: The circuits lock into place, the heavy steel door grinds upward, and you slip out into the quiet New York dusk just in time.
endings.failed: The time expires, the emergency relays shut down completely, and the sound of failing metal fills the dark room.
